style_lock.diagram_style: Clean flat-vector educational diagram style, muted professional color palette (blues, grays, one warm accent color), no photographic texture, no gradients, generous white space, thin consistent line weights, simple geometric icons, textbook-infographic quality. No readable body text beyond short labels explicitly specified in the prompt. No logos, no watermarks.
style_lock.photo_style: IMPORTANT: every person depicted must be Japanese/East Asian in appearance -- straight black or dark brown hair, East Asian facial features, light-to-medium skin tone. This is for a textbook used by Japanese students and professionals in Japan, so all figures (presenters and audience members alike) should look Japanese, not Black, not South Asian, not Middle Eastern, not White/Western. Warm, professional flat-vector illustration style (not photorealistic, not cartoon), generic non-identifiable figures, professional business-casual attire, muted professional color palette consistent with the diagram style, welcoming but not overly stylized tone. No readable text anywhere in the image. No logos, no watermarks, no brand names. absolutely NO flags of any kind, no national emblems, no seals, no stars-and-stripes or similar patriotic imagery -- if a banner or signage element is wanted for a civic/government setting, use a completely plain solid-color rectangular banner or panel with no pattern, no stripes, no stars, no crest, no text.

images.title: The 3 Phases of Preparation vertical stack
images.description: REVISED MULTIPLE TIMES -- FINAL METHOD DIFFERS FROM SIMPLE GENERATION. v1: three separate phase containers, left empty space in sparser Writing/Practice boxes. v2: asked the model to render all 8 text labels itself -- missing element, wrong phase boundaries, messy artifacts. v3: pure-PIL hand-drawn -- functionally correct but 'cheap looking' (generic icons, bad proportions, dead whitespace). v4: OpenAI-generated unlabeled 8-box scaffold in one shot -- genuinely well-designed icons, but only rendered 7 boxes (Drafting+Honing merged), breaking the 5/2/1 color grouping. v5: retried the 8-box scaffold with heavy explicit counting language -- got WORSE (6 boxes, missing Delivery entirely). CONCLUSION: the model cannot reliably generate 8 correctly-separated, correctly-grouped boxes in a single connected-flowchart image, no matter how the prompt is worded. FINAL WORKING METHOD (v6): generate the 8 icons ONCE as a simple 2x4 GRID SHEET instead (a grid is much easier for the model to keep separated than a tall connected stack) -- see the 'icon_sheet_prompt' field below -- then slice the sheet into 8 individual icons and build the entire stack (boxes, arrows, phase-color bars grouped 5/2/1, text labels) deterministically in PIL via scripts_local/build_three_phases_final.py. This guarantees correct count/grouping/spacing while still getting OpenAI's genuinely well-designed icon artwork. Generate via: python scripts_local/generate_image_transparent.py --prompt "<icon_sheet_prompt>" --out raw/01-1-icon-sheet.png --size 1024x1536, then python scripts_local/build_three_phases_final.py.
images.icon_sheet_prompt: A clean flat-vector icon sheet, transparent background (no background at all, artwork only), showing exactly 8 icons arranged in a strict 2-column by 4-row grid, evenly spaced with generous equal padding between every icon so each one is clearly isolated from its neighbors. Professional published-textbook icon style, consistent stroke weight, consistent muted blue-gray color, consistent visual size (all 8 icons should occupy roughly the same bounding-box footprint, none dramatically bigger or smaller than another). Reading order left-column-top-to-bottom then right-column-top-to-bottom: (1) a target/bullseye. (2) a speech-bubble containing a small star. (3) a document/page with horizontal text lines. (4) three stacked/overlapping cube building blocks. (5) a presentation slide or bar-chart-on-easel icon. (6) a single pencil, alone, no other object near it. (7) a single pair of scissors, alone, in its own grid cell, not touching or overlapping the pencil icon in cell 6. (8) a person shown mid-speech with a small sound/speech indicator near their mouth. Each of the 8 icons must be fully separate and isolated in its own grid cell with visible padding on all sides -- no two icons should touch, overlap, or share a cell. No text, letters, numbers, or words anywhere in the image. No grid lines, no cell borders, no background shapes -- just the 8 icons floating in their implied grid positions. NOTE: actual rendered sheet came out in ROW-MAJOR order (row0: target,message | row1: document,blocks | row2: chart,pencil | row3: scissors,person), not the column-major order requested -- build_three_phases_final.py's SHEET_POSITIONS_ROW_MAJOR list already accounts for this.

images.title: The Logic Tree diagram (core framework — highest priority)
images.description: A literal tree illustration with five conceptual parts bottom to top: Roots, Trunk, Branches (3), Leaves, Fruit. ISSUES FOUND ACROSS PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS: (1) the image model's own text/callout placement was unreliable (mismatched labels) -- fixed by removing all text from the prompt and adding labels afterward via a separate PIL script (draw_logic_tree_labels.py) at exact hand-specified coordinates; (2) asking for a 'flat, texture-free background' in prompt TEXT backfired badly -- the model added a dramatic vignette/glow gradient and drifted the leaf color off-green; (3) FIXED PROPERLY this time via the native API parameter `background: "transparent"` (gpt-image-1 feature, called via generate_image_transparent.py using raw HTTP since the installed openai SDK version doesn't expose this param) rather than prompt wording -- no keying/flood-fill step needed at all, no enclosed-patch artifacts possible, since there's no background color to begin with.
images.prompt: A clean flat-vector illustration of a simple stylized tree used as an educational diagram, with NO text, letters, numbers, or words anywhere in the image, and NO background of any kind -- the image should contain only the tree artwork itself. The tree has, from bottom to top: an underground root system below a horizontal ground line (roots visible, spreading downward and outward), a single vertical trunk rising from the ground line, exactly three branches splitting off from the upper trunk, leaves clustered on those branches filling most of the canopy, and a small cluster of 2-3 rounded fruit shapes nestled among the leaves on the right-hand side of the canopy, near the top, in a warm accent color distinct from the green leaves. Muted natural color palette: browns for the roots and trunk, natural greens for the leaves, one warm accent color (e.g. orange or soft red) for the fruit. Leave clear open space to the right of the entire tree (roughly the right third of the image) completely empty, with no leaves, branches, or decoration extending into it -- that space is reserved for text labels to be added afterward. Center the tree in the left two-thirds of the image, ground line roughly two-thirds of the way down the image height.

labels.target: top-right of canopy, where the fruit shapes are
one of the three branches (the woody stem, not a leaf)
a leaf shape in the canopy
the vertical trunk, between the ground line and the lowest branch
the underground root system, below the ground line
